abilities.name: Royal Reed Archery
_curatorNotes: No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.
N2 has two hitmarks [12, 15]; one entry recorded using cancel frames from attackFrames[1] (swap=15, N=32), sourced from the last hitmark per recipe.

A1 passive 'Black Kite's Enigma' reduces aimedFrames at cast time by int(0.285 × min(energy, 20) × 60) frames. Base frames (zero energy, no reduction) recorded for all chargeHits[]. At max 20 energy: skip=342f; Shadowpiercing Shot swap reduces from 379f to 37f, D/J from 368f to 26f. Reviewer to decide how to represent the energy-scaled timing.
Aimed shots (all chargeHits levels) are disabled while the Q buff 'Twilight Meditation' (burstBuffKey) is active — gcsim returns an error if Aimed() is called during that window.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Electro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of lightning that deals Electro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Shadowpiercing Shot which can pierce enemies, dealing Electro DMG to enemies along its path. After the Shadowpiercing Shot is fully charged, Sethos cannot move around.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands
_curatorNotes: Skill energy refund on reaction not authored in effects[] — gcsim subscribes to OnElectroCharged, OnLunarCharged, OnSuperconduct, OnOverload, OnSwirlElectro, OnHyperbloom, OnQuicken, OnAggravate and refunds skillEnergyRegen[lvl]=12 energy on hit. Likely onReaction trigger with electro-reaction condition. Reviewer to author effect.
abilities.description: Gathers the might of thunder, dealing AoE Electro DMG and quickly retreating. If this attack triggers Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reactions, Sethos recovers a certain amount of Elemental Energy.

abilities.name: Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer
_curatorNotes: Changed behavior from 'stance' to 'instant' per recipe (stance reserved for Hu Tao/Cyno/Raiden/Furina + queue-flagged; Sethos is Tier A). Q grants an 8s self-buff 'Twilight Meditation' (burstBuffKey) that converts Normal Attacks to Electro Dusk Bolts (AttackTagExtra, ICDTagElementalBurst; DMG = ATK × burstEM[lvl] + burstEM[lvl] × EM, counted as Charged Attack DMG). Canceled when Sethos leaves the field (onCharacterSwap hook in sethos.go). Dusk Bolt EM scaling uses burstEM[] table (talent-level-gated). Reviewer to decide whether duration field or self-buff entry is warranted, and whether 'stance' should be reinstated given the N-replacement behavior.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim sethos/burst.go: buff only.
abilities.description:
Perform a secret rite, entering the "Twilight Meditation" state, during which Sethos's Normal Attacks will be converted into enemy-piercing Dusk Bolts: Deal Electro DMG to opponents in its path, with DMG increased based on Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
Sethos cannot perform Aimed Shots while in this state.
DMG dealt by Dusk Bolts is considered Charged Attack DMG.
This effect will be canceled when Sethos leaves the field.

passives.name: Black Kite's Enigma
passives.description: When Aiming, the charging time is decreased by 0.285s based on each point of Sethos's current Elemental Energy. Charging time can be reduced to a minimum of 0.3s through this method and a maximum of 20 Energy can be tallied. If a Shadowpiercing Shot is fired, consume the tallied amount of Elemental Energy; if it is a Charge Level 1 shot, then consume 50% of the tallied amount of Elemental Energy.

passives.name: The Sand King's Boon
_curatorNotes: Manual trigger inherited from generator. Probable trigger: onHit scoped to Shadowpiercing Shot (AttackTagExtra, Abil=='Shadowpiercing Shot') when Scorching Sandshade (a4Key) status is active. In gcsim (aimed.go): FlatDmg += 7 × EM applied inside ShadowPierce() when a4Key is active. Scorching Sandshade lifecycle: starts infinite on Init(), first hit resets to 5s; deactivates after 4 hits or expiry; 15s ICD (a4IcdKey) before reactivation. Target scope: self (flat DMG addition to Sethos's Shadowpiercing Shot). Reviewer to model cycling status and ICD.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: The Sand King's Boon — effects[0] (damage scaling 700 em) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/sethos/aimed.go:156-162` — inside `ShadowPierce()`, `if c.StatusIsActive(a4Key) { ai.FlatDmg += 7 * em }`. The Scorching Sandshade status itself cycles: infinite from `a4()` (`asc.go:38-45`), rewritten to 5s on the first hit that consumes it, deleted after 4 hits (`makeA4cb`, `asc.go:47-74`), then re-armed 15s later (`startA4Icd`, `asc.go:76-82`). Retained: the coefficient (`7 × EM` = 700%), that it applies to Shadowpiercing Shots **only**, and the full Sandshade lifecycle (infinite → 5s on first hit → off after 4 hits → 15s ICD → back). Drop "Reviewer to model cycling status and ICD" — there is nothing to model it with. ⚠️ The CONVERT shape (`chargeFlatDmg`, scaling em 700, `passive`) over-claims on two independent axes and would be a false always-on chip: Sethos's charged class holds three members in our own data (`chargeHits`: Aimed Shot, Fully-Charged Aimed Shot, Shadowpiercing Shot) plus the burst's Dusk Bolts, which gcsim also tags `AttackTagExtra` (`attack.go:63-66`) — only one of the four carries the bonus — and even on that one it holds for at most 4 shots in 5s out of every 20. ⚠️ `filter.abilityName: "Shadowpiercing Shot"` *does* resolve for Sethos (both readers append the `chargeHits` sub-name; `C`/`C2` → the last entry), but a filter belongs to a trigger and a flat-DMG stat carries none — and an `onHit` buff would land the bonus on the swing *after* the one that earned it.
passives.description:
Sethos gains the "Scorching Sandshade" effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shadowpiercing Shots by 700% of Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
The Scorching Sandshade effect will be canceled when any of the following conditions are met:
· 5s after a Shadowpiercing Shot first hits an opponent.
· After 4 Shadowpiercing Shots strike opponents.

When a Shadowpiercing Shot affected by Scorching Sandshade first hits an opponent, Sethos will regain Scorching Sandshade after 15s.

constellations.name: Sealed Shrine's Spiritsong
_curatorNotes: Manual trigger inherited from generator. In gcsim (cons.go): AddAttackMod fires when AttackTag==AttackTagExtra && Abil=='Shadowpiercing Shot', applying CR+15%. This is a permanent conditional modifier, not a triggered buff — effectively unconditional while Sethos fires Shadowpiercing Shots. Probable trigger: none (always-on conditional stat modifier for specific attack type); target scope: self. Reviewer to decide representation.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 "Sealed Shrine's Spiritsong" — effects[0] (buff critRate 15) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/sethos/cons.go:31-49` — a permanent `AddAttackMod` returning CR +0.15 only when `atk.Info.AttackTag == AttackTagExtra && atk.Info.Abil == "Shadowpiercing Shot"`. No window, no trigger: it is a per-attack modifier, not a buff. Retained: that this is an attack-scoped stat modifier with no lifetime (gcsim `modifier.NewBase(..., -1)` + an `Abil` test), and that it cannot be expressed because there is no ability-scoped CRIT stat. Drop "Reviewer to decide representation." ⚠️ This is the brief's own worked RETIRE example, and Sethos is the narrower case: `passive` + `critRate: 15` would print a flat "+15% CRIT Rate" on the always-on chip for a bonus that reaches one named shot inside the charged class, while his normals, Aimed Shots and Dusk Bolts get nothing. ⛔ There is no `chargedCritRate` member and ⛔ none should be minted for one holder — the element-scoped `*CritDmg` family exists but has no CRIT-Rate twin, and an ability-scoped one is a different axis again.
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Shadowpiercing Shot is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Papyrus Scripture of Silent Secrets
_curatorNotes: Manual trigger inherited from generator. C2 adds up to 2 stacks of 15% Electro DMG Bonus (10s each, independently timed). Three trigger conditions in gcsim (cons.go + asc.go + skill.go): (a) energy consumed via Aimed Shot — a1Consume() calls c2AddStack(c2ConsumingKey); (b) E skill triggering electro reactions that refund energy — skillRefundHook() calls c2AddStack(c2RegainingKey); (c) Q cast — Burst() calls c2AddStack(c2BurstKey). Stacks cap at 2 (min of total active statuses). Probable trigger: three separate conditions requiring multiple effect entries or compound trigger. Target scope: self.
constellations.description:
When any of the following conditions are met, Sethos gains a 15% Electro DMG Bonus for 10s that may stack twice, with each stack duration counted independently:
· Consuming Elemental Energy through Aimed Shots. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" to trigger this condition.
· Regaining Elemental Energy by triggering Elemental Reactions using Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands.
· Using Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer.
